'''Wroat''' is the capital city of the nation of [[Breland]], housing both the royal family and the royal parliament. The great walled city is built on opposing banks of the [[Howling River]] just before it flows into the [[Dagger River]]. The city also occupies a man-made island that sits in the middle of the river and it is here that [[Brokenblade Castle]] as well as the [[King's Citadel|Citadel]] can be found.<ref name="5N-p60">{{Cite book/Five Nations|60,61,62}}</ref>
